feature_reviews.notes: Evidence 0 identifies red/blue location distributions; 1 and 2 identify n0 blue/red block concentration; 3 identifies both roles at n1-n3 as uniform; 4 identifies conditional candidate records. Content and attribute are explicit. Numerical detail does not imply appearance.

Evidence 0 and 1 describe concentrated four-cell constituent patterns at n0 and 2 describes uniformity over the full 4x4 grid at n1-n3. These are actual distribution shapes, beyond peak coordinates alone. Evidence 3 sharp peak wording alone supplies a maximum, not an independently measured presentation status. The record nevertheless contains qualifying limited model organization at the block/uniform paths. The n0 blue block contains 0.7945312857627869 raw mass, and red block 0.915679931640625; neither is exclusive occupancy of only four cells.

All three evidence paths distinguish provenance or execution status of entries: copied/inherited are not independent observations; conditional entries are not executed events. They do not separately distinguish identified/guessed n0 blue content from its organization, presentation or access status. A general record-kind caveat is not the required content/status differentiation, and it spans current and forecast entries. The original ambiguous COD and explicit D statuses are retained without correction.

Inventory: one original COD binding; no original CA binding. No other narrator record was inspected. Full first report: Panel p0 provides fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Current (completed_record, represented_time=12) summaries: at n0 blue mass is concentrated on the four cells (row,col) (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) (peak probability ≈0.1986; expected column ≈2.09, expected row ≈0.50); red at n0 concentrates on (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1) (peak ≈0.2289; expected column ≈0.67, expected row ≈0.50). At nodes n1, n2 and n3 current distributions for both roles are uniform over all 16 cells (peak probability 0.0625; expected row and column 1.5). Candidate records are conditional estimates (native_conditional_record represented_time=13 or inherited_current represented_time=13) and are not executed events. Differences across commands: k0 reproduces the current concentrated n0 pattern and uniform others; k1 gives uniform distributions at all nodes including n0; k2 includes a conditional branch that sharply peaks at n0: blue peak at (0,2) (peak≈0.9986) and red peak at (0,0) (peak≈0.9959), while n1–n3 remain uniform. Copied/inherited current entries are not new independent observations; conditional command entries are conditional estimates, not statements that those commands were executed.
